seo.title: Your Company — electronic music club in Tashkent
seo.description: Techno, house and electro in a basement on Shakhrisabz St: parties Thursday to Saturday until 06:00, residents and guests, a Funktion-One sound system. Tickets online.
seo.answer: Your Company is an electronic music club in Tashkent at 5 Shakhrisabz St: techno, house and electro from Thursday to Saturday, 22:00 to 06:00. Entry is 18+, online tickets cost 120,000–200,000 UZS and 50,000 UZS more on the door; photos and video are not allowed on the dancefloor.

listing.description: A website for a club, festival, bar or events agency. Acid dithering and glitch in WebGL, a party line-up with artists and prices, club rules and an FAQ styled like a terminal.

business.street: 5 Shakhrisabz St, entrance from the courtyard

sections.title: Music louder than the city
sections.subtitle: A basement on Shakhrisabz, a Funktion-One rig, a dark dancefloor and strict rules: no phones, no VIP, no random crowd.

sections.label: The club
sections.title: A 400-capacity basement where you hear every note
sections.text: Your Company opened in 2022 in a former storeroom under a residential block. The sound was tuned by engineers who have installed systems in European clubs: Funktion-One, acoustic panelling and twenty minutes of silence before every night to check it. There’s no VIP area and no tables — just the dancefloor, the bar and a chill-out zone in the courtyard.

items.title: No photos or video
items.text: We cover phone cameras with a sticker at the door. The dancefloor is not a place for stories.

items.title: 18+ only
items.text: We check ID for everyone at the door, no exceptions.

items.title: Respect
items.text: No harassment, discrimination or aggression. Anyone breaking this is shown out with no refund.

items.title: Door policy
items.text: We look at your mood, not your outfit. No one drunk gets in.

items.title: Look after yourself
items.text: Water at the bar is free and a medic is on duty in the chill-out zone.

items.quote: The first club in Tashkent where the sound doesn’t hurt even right by the speakers. Walked out at six in the morning with no ringing in my ears.
items.author: timur.wav

items.quote: The camera sticker annoyed me at first, then I realised I’d just danced for the first time in a year.
items.author: malika

items.quote: I’ve played plenty of basements, but here the crowd actually listens. I’ll be back with a live set.
items.author: Marten Oy

items.a: Online tickets cost from 120,000 to 200,000 UZS depending on the night. If places are left, tickets on the door are 50,000 UZS more.
18 and over only. We check ID for everyone at the door.
Nothing strict: come in whatever you can dance in. We look at the mood, not the brands.

items.q: Can I film on my phone?
items.a: Not on the dancefloor — we cover the camera with a sticker at the door. In the courtyard chill-out zone, yes.
Yes, at least 48 hours before the night starts — via the link in your ticket email.

items.q: How do I get there at night?
items.a: The entrance is through the courtyard of 5 Shakhrisabz St. After closing a partner taxi waits at the door, and the metro opens at 05:00.
